name: history-notice-cleanup
goal: Keep truncated history usable without repeated limitation banners in the navbar or content.

evidence: A truncated index currently renders the same limitation notice in selectors and console. Requested: keep controls and history data, omit both notices.

Navbar SSR explicitly required the old message; the responsive real-console matrix used only complete indexes. Invert SSR expectation and serve a truncated index in that existing matrix; capture before asserting no notice.
